decision_boundary.bar_rule: An 8-hour bar is usable only when open_time plus 8 hours is no later than the decision boundary.
decision_boundary.fill_rule: The executable open at the decision boundary is not an input to the strategy.
decision_boundary.funding_rule: DecisionContext funding is required to contain only events strictly before the decision boundary.

ranking_rule: Rank the raw finite long-desirability score without clipping; buy the highest tail and short the lowest tail, breaking only exact numerical ties by symbol.

features.availability_rule: Both adjacent closes are from fully closed 8-hour bars.
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if closes are insufficient, non-finite, or nonpositive.

features.availability_rule: The 90 aligned return bars end immediately before the three-bar shock horizon.
features.lag: three fully closed 8-hour bars relative to the decision boundary
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if aligned history is insufficient or BTC variance is at or below 1e-8.
features.transformation: covariance(symbol_return, btc_return) divided by variance(btc_return), clipped to [-1, 3]

features.availability_rule: Uses exactly the latest three fully closed aligned returns and a beta estimated without those rows.
features.lag: available after the third shock-horizon bar closes
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol when beta or aligned returns are unavailable.
features.transformation: sum over three bars of symbol_return minus rolling_btc_beta times btc_return

features.availability_rule: The 63 residual bars end immediately before the three-bar shock horizon.
features.lag: three fully closed 8-hour bars relative to the decision boundary
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if sample volatility is non-finite or at or below 1e-8.
features.transformation: sample standard deviation of beta residuals; the shock is divided by this value times square_root(3)

features.availability_rule: All volume observations belong to fully closed bars; the numerator is the latest completed three-bar sum.
features.lag: available after the latest 8-hour bar closes
features.lookback: latest three-bar sum against the median of up to 90 completed three-bar sums
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol for invalid volume, fewer than 30 rolling sums, or a nonpositive baseline median.
features.transformation: log(latest_three_bar_volume / median_history), clipped to [0, 2], then multiplied by 0.35 and added to one

features.availability_rule: Only funding events supplied before the decision boundary are eligible.
features.lookback: 3-day mean scaled by sample volatility from up to 30 days
features.missing_rule: Use zero until at least 12 valid events exist or when the historical scale is degenerate.
features.transformation: recent mean divided by historical sample standard deviation, clipped to [-3, 3], with weight -0.25 in long desirability

features.availability_rule: Uses BTC returns from fully closed bars only.
features.missing_rule: Use symmetric sleeve gross when history is insufficient or the aggregate return is non-finite.
features.transformation: compound the 180 log returns; move 0.05 gross toward long above +0.10 or toward short below -0.10
